parent_objective: design staged measured execution route after no-rollout protocol audit
blocked_by: must design measured execution scope and guardrails before any environment rollout
supersedes: direct measured rollout execution after M1684

public_gates: M1685 must design measured execution without executing rollout
M1685 must choose small smoke full rollout or staged smoke-to-full route
M1685 must preserve all_72 and explicit-window strata
M1685 must preserve L1 L2-current-tiled and L3-reset controls
M1685 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured execution route after protocol audit before any rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design drops strata or control-substitution profiles
stop if profile-specific tuning is allowed
stop if private holdout or paper-level claim is admitted
fallback_plan: route to measured execution preflight if design is feasible
route to protocol repair if measured execution cannot preserve controls
route to branch synthesis if execution route is too large for current cadence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1684 audits no-rollout protocol and admits measured-execution design only

admission_evidence: M1684 audits M1683 as complete no-rollout protocol with 864 workload cells zero leakage and zero execution
allowed_updates: M1685 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured execution preflight, protocol repair, or branch synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; execution design must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls.
history_necessity_tests: design must not claim history necessity before measured execution
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured execution shows controls solve tasks, record a valid reactive/finite-window result rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A staged public measured execution route can be designed from the M1683 protocol without executing rollout or weakening controller-family controls.
success_criteria: design chooses smoke full or staged execution scope
design preserves all_72 explicit-window L1 L2-current-tiled and L3-reset controls
design chooses one execution preflight repair or synthesis route
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits strata or control-substitution profiles
design routes directly to rollout execution private holdout promotion or paper evidence
design claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
decision_rule: M1685 passes if it designs measured execution and keeps execution blocked.
